title: Anchorage Digital Acquires Routable, Extending Its Institutional Platform to the Payment Rails of the World's Largest Companies
body_markdown:
## A payments business that stands on its own


Routable is a complementary, fiat-native business, and that is the point. Anchorage Digital brings the regulated digital asset side, while Routable provides a proven payments business, with revenue built on payment volume. Together, they make Anchorage Digital the single end-to-end platform for the world’s most tech-forward corporations, one partner for every dollar, whether it settles over traditional rails or digital ones.


The combined company serves clients across both businesses from day one, with integrated offerings rolling out over the coming quarters. To find out more about Routable by Anchorage Digital, please visit[Routable.com](http://routable.com/) .


**About Routable**


Routable is the enterprise payouts platform for businesses that need to move money at scale. Through a developer-first API, Routable enables businesses to onboard and verify payees, automate tax and compliance workflows, and orchestrate high-volume payouts to millions of creators, contractors, sellers, drivers, affiliates, and other recipients across 220+ countries.


Routable supports both fiat and stablecoin payouts, with built-in tax compliance, including W-9s, W-8s, and 1099s, and infrastructure designed for the security, controls, and auditability required by the enterprise.


Routable is a subsidiary of Anchorage Digital, home to America’s first federally chartered digital asset bank powering modern financial markets. For more information, visit[www.routable.com](http://www.routable.com/) .


**About Anchorage Digital**


Anchorage Digital is the proven infrastructure layer for modern financial markets that gives institutions a single platform to participate in digital assets, including prime services, tokenization, stablecoins, and the governance framework for agentic finance. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., America’s first federally regulated digital asset bank, Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore; Anchorage Digital NY, which holds a BitLicense from the New York Department of Financial Services; and self-custody wallet Porto by Anchorage Digital. Anchorage Digital Bank also offers fiat custody services through an FDIC-insured, licensed sub-custodian. Anchorage Digital is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with a valuation of $4.2 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at[anchorage.com](https://www.anchorage.com/) ,[X](https://twitter.com/Anchorage) ,[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/c/AnchorageDigital) , and[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/anchorage/) .
